title: Record page: opening a record sends one approvals query and one record fetch, not three and two
body:
## Source

Read on objectui main `efa9cb4fa`, the HotCRM lead record `/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_lead/record/lZxZJxDxLzE08lyU`: the network log of one open holds

- `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=crm_lead&recordId=…` three times (identical), and
- `GET /api/v1/data/crm_lead?populate=organization_id,created_by,updated_by,owning_business_unit_id,owner_id,converted_account,…&top=1&filter=…` and `GET /api/v1/data/crm_lead?populate=converted_account,converted_contact,converted_opportunity,duplicate_of_lead,duplicate_of_contact&top=1&filter=…` — the same record twice with two populate lists, the second a subset of the first.

Plus one `sys_activity` query and three approvals queries from the header, the activity tab and the approvals rail each asking on their own.

## Target

1. One approvals query per record open, shared by every consumer on the page (a record-scoped query key, or a provider on the record page that the header, the rail and the Activity tab read).
2. One record fetch: the page computes the union of the populate lists its sections need and fetches once; a section that needs a wider populate than the page loaded triggers one refetch with the union, never a parallel second fetch.
3. A test that mounts the record page and counts requests by URL: approvals 1, record 1.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` and the hooks it mounts (the approvals rail hook, the record loader), `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` if it fetches on its own, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. The request-count test; the network log of a lead open pasted in the PR shows one of each.
2. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail test` green.

## Evidence

No screenshot; the measurements above are the evidence.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 fourth review: objectui main `efa9cb4fa`, HotCRM `4f82b815` on platform 18.0.0-next.2, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (dark, en). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed on the repository it belongs to, verbatim: 「全部立卡，平台问题到 objectui，审计日志核查到 objectstack，HotCRM 转化流程到 hotcrm。」</sub>
